title: Drunk Angry Man vs. 6 Cops
description:
On November 6, 2021, Police responded to a fight complaint between a man and a woman that occurred at The Warming Center in La Crosse, WI. After the man was separated, he pulled a knife from his pocket and lunged at others. 

When officers arrived and obtained details about the incident, the man became more impatient and displayed many signs of aggression. He stated that if they tried to arrest him, he would start swinging.
